escena.titulo: Disney: two ways into a country

turnos.t: Does a multinational enter every country the same way?

No. Disneyland Paris opened in 1992, as Euro Disney. Disney took a minority stake in a listed company and managed the park. Shanghai Disneyland opened in 2016 as a joint venture, with the state-owned Shendi Group owning fifty-seven percent.
Not at first. It copied the no-alcohol policy of the American parks, but French visitors expected wine with meals. It lost heavily in its first years, and Disney lifted the ban within about a year.
